preflight_checks.description: Identify target feature / execution code paths for instrumentation
Define 2-4 on-call operational questions (instrumentation without questions forbidden)

postflight_checks.description: Verify all signals map directly to defined on-call questions
Verify structured logs contain stable event names + correlation IDs
Verify metric cardinality safety (absence of unbounded label values)
Verify alerts are symptom-based (cause-based paging alerts forbidden)

outputs.path_pattern: Instrumentation code within target source files
outputs.description: Structured logging, metrics, and tracing instrumentation written concurrently with features

references.description: Pre-release observability checklist for implementation and review (transplanted from agent-skills 2026-07-17)
